dynamicTools.description: Work with the person's other threads. A thread you assign is an ordinary thread the person can open, talk to and stop; its agent works on your brief. A message from another thread is a user message that begins with <thread-message from="<thread id>" title="<title>"/>, with report="completed", "stopped" or "failed" when it reports how a turn you started ended. A turn another thread started (by a brief or a message) reports its last reply back to that thread by itself, so do not answer one with `message`; use `message` to start or continue an exchange. A message to a running thread waits for its turn to end. Read a thread to see where it stands or what it did; message it to ask for its judgment or have it act. The person may mention threads: <thread-ref id="<thread id>" title="<title>" project="<project>"/>; reach one by its id.
dynamicTools.name: chirality

tools.description: Start a new thread with a title and a brief (its first message), in this thread's project or another, and return its id. Model, reasoning effort and access are this thread's unless named; access can only be the same or lower (the new thread's agent asks the person for more).

brief.description: The work, as the new thread's first message.

effort.description: A reasoning effort: low, medium, high, xhigh.

project.description: A project's name or path, from `threads`; this thread's project when left out.

workflow.description: A workflow's name or id, for the new thread to follow.

tools.name: assign

tools.description: Send text to another thread, to start or continue an exchange. It starts a turn there, or waits until the turn running there ends; that turn's last reply comes back to you by itself.
tools.name: message

tools.description: The threads you can address, in every project, most recently active first: each with its title, project, whether it is running, idle or waiting on the person, and whether you assigned it or it assigned you.
tools.name: threads

tools.description: Read another thread, in any project, a subagent's too, to see where it stands or what it did; it is not woken. Gives its title, project, status and last error, then its items newest first, each numbered; `before` a number gives the items before it.

before.description: Only the items numbered below this.

limit.description: How many items at most (20 unless given).

view.description: messages (the default): messages in and the agent's final replies; activity adds commands, file changes and tool calls.

tools.name: read

tools.description: End an assignment you made: no more reports come from that thread.
tools.name: close
